chains.name: McDonald's
chains.blurb: Burgers, fries, McNuggets and all-day value under the McValue menu.

deals.title: McValue Buy One, Add One for $1
deals.details: Buy one eligible McValue item at full price and add a second of equal or lesser value for $1. Breakfast: Sausage McMuffin, Sausage Biscuit, Sausage Burrito, Hash Browns; lunch to late night: McChicken, Double Cheeseburger, 6-pc McNuggets, Small Fries. Prices and participation may vary.

deals.title: McValue Meal Deal from $5
deals.details: McDouble or McChicken, small fries, 4-pc Chicken McNuggets and a small soft drink. Listed as 'starting at $5'; price may be higher at some restaurants. Prices and participation may vary.

chains.name: Wendy's
chains.blurb: Ohio-born burger chain known for square patties, the Frosty and Biggie Deals.

deals.title: $4 Biggie Bites
deals.details: Choose one: Crispy Chicken Sandwich, Jr. Cheeseburger, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, 4-pc Nuggets or Jr. Fry; then a second: 4-pc Nuggets, Jr. Fry or small soft drink. Participating U.S. restaurants; price and options may vary by location.

deals.title: $6 Biggie Bag
deals.details: Choice of Crispy Chicken Sandwich, Jr. Cheeseburger, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger or Double Stack, plus 4-pc Nuggets, Jr. Fry and small soft drink. Participating U.S. restaurants; price may vary.

deals.title: $8 Biggie Bundle
deals.details: Two sandwiches (Crispy Chicken Sandwich, Jr. Cheeseburger, Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger or Double Stack) plus Jr. Fry and small soft drink. Participating U.S. restaurants; price may vary.

chains.name: Burger King
chains.blurb: Home of the flame-grilled Whopper, with rotating offers in the Royal Perks app.

chains.name: Taco Bell
chains.blurb: Late-night tacos, burritos and Crunchwraps with a dedicated value menu.

deals.title: Luxe Value Menu: 10 items at $3 or less
deals.details: Ten items priced at $3 or less (five new, five carried over from the former Cravings Value Menu). Prices may vary by location.

deals.title: Tuesday Drops (app)
deals.details: App-only for Taco Bell Rewards members: a new drop every Tuesday at 2 PM PT, first come, first served, in limited quantities. Drops vary week to week (one example was a Luxe Value Menu item for $1).

chains.name: Chipotle
chains.blurb: Build-your-own burritos and bowls.

deals.title: Chipotle U Rewards (student loyalty)
deals.details: College students who verify enrollment through ID.me earn 12 points per $1 instead of the regular 10, plus 1,000 bonus points on joining. App/rewards account required; this is extra points, not a price discount.

chains.name: Qdoba
chains.blurb: Burritos, bowls and queso with free add-ons like guac.

chains.name: Subway
chains.blurb: Made-to-order subs with daily featured sandwiches.

deals.title: $4.99 Sub of the Day
deals.details: A different featured six-inch sub each day of the week for $4.99. Prices higher in AK and HI; participation may vary.

deals.title: $6.99 Meal of the Day
deals.details: The day's featured six-inch sub for $6.99 (footlong $9.99) with two cookies or a bag of chips and a small fountain drink. Prices higher in CA, AK and HI; participation may vary.

deals.title: Value Menu: 15 entrees under $5
deals.details: Subway's value menu launched April 2026 with 15 entrees priced under $5. Prices and participation may vary.

chains.name: Jimmy John's
chains.blurb: Fast-delivery sub sandwiches on fresh-baked bread.

chains.name: Jersey Mike's
chains.blurb: Jersey Shore-style subs sliced to order.

chains.name: Penn Station East Coast Subs
chains.blurb: Cincinnati-based grilled subs, cheesesteaks and fresh-cut fries.

chains.name: Raising Cane's
chains.blurb: Chicken finger combos with Cane's sauce, Texas toast and crinkle fries.

chains.name: Chick-fil-A
chains.blurb: Chicken sandwiches, nuggets and waffle fries; closed Sundays.

chains.name: KFC
chains.blurb: Fried chicken buckets, tenders and bowls.

deals.title: $10 Taste of KFC Fried Chicken Meal
deals.details: 4 pieces of fried chicken, 2 mashed potato sides and 2 biscuits for $10. Price and participation may vary by location.

deals.title: $5 Mac & Cheese Bowl
deals.details: Mac and cheese topped with crispy chicken nuggets and a three-cheese blend, listed at $5. Price and participation may vary by location.

chains.name: Popeyes
chains.blurb: Louisiana-style fried chicken, tenders and the chicken sandwich.

chains.name: Arby's
chains.blurb: Roast beef sandwiches and curly fries.

deals.title: 2 for $6 Everyday Value
deals.details: Mix and match two select sandwiches or wraps for $6. Eligible items, price and participation may vary by location.

chains.name: Skyline Chili
chains.blurb: Cincinnati-style chili served as 3-Ways and cheese coneys.

chains.name: Gold Star Chili
chains.blurb: Cincinnati-style chili parlor with coneys, ways and burgers.

chains.name: Donatos
chains.blurb: Columbus-born thin-crust pizza with edge-to-edge toppings.

chains.name: Domino's
chains.blurb: Delivery and carryout pizza, wings and sides.

deals.title: Mix & Match: any 2 or more for $6.99 each
deals.details: Choose any two or more eligible items for $6.99 each (2-item minimum). Prices higher at some locations; participation may vary.

deals.title: Weeklong Carryout Deal $7.99
deals.details: Carryout only: large 1-topping pizza, 8-piece wings or boneless chicken, or other eligible items for $7.99 each. Prices and participation may vary by store.

chains.name: Papa Johns
chains.blurb: Delivery pizza known for garlic dipping sauce.

deals.title: Papa Pairings from $6.99 each
deals.details: Choose two or more eligible items (select medium 1-topping pizzas, Oven-Toasted Sandwiches, wings, breadsticks, cheesesticks, garlic knots, desserts) starting at $6.99 each, delivery or carryout. Participating locations; eligible items and prices vary by location.

chains.name: Little Caesars
chains.blurb: Hot-N-Ready carryout pizza and Crazy Bread.

chains.name: Marco's Pizza
chains.blurb: Toledo-founded pizza chain with dough made in-store daily.

chains.name: Pizza Hut
chains.blurb: Pan pizza, wings and Melts for delivery or carryout.

deals.title: $7 Deal Lover's Menu
deals.details: Medium one-topping pizzas, Melts, wings, pastas, sides and desserts at $7 each when you order two or more. Priced higher in some locations; availability and participation vary.

chains.name: Buffalo Wild Wings
chains.blurb: Sports bar with wings in two dozen sauces and dry rubs.

deals.title: BOGO Bone-In Wings Tuesday
deals.details: Buy one order of bone-in (traditional) wings on Tuesday and get a second of equal or lesser value discounted. BWW's own pages differ on the discount (homepage: 50% off the second order for Rewards members; promos page: 100% off), so check the app. Participating locations.

deals.title: BOGO Boneless Wings Thursday
deals.details: Buy one order of boneless wings on Thursday and get one of equal or lesser value free. Fine print varies on dine-in vs takeout/delivery; participating locations.

chains.name: Wingstop
chains.blurb: Classic and boneless wings in bold flavors with seasoned fries.

deals.title: Boneless Meal Deal
deals.details: 20 boneless wings in up to 4 flavors, a large seasoned fry and 2 dips. Listed at $16.99 at one location and $18.99 at another; price varies by location.

chains.name: Panera Bread
chains.blurb: Bakery-cafe with soups, sandwiches, salads and the Unlimited Sip Club.

chains.name: Starbucks
chains.blurb: Espresso drinks, Refreshers and study-friendly cafes.

deals.title: Free Mod Mondays (Rewards)
deals.details: Starbucks Rewards members get a coupon for one free drink customization (including cold foam) one Monday a month. App/Rewards account required.

deals.title: Free brewed coffee and tea refills in cafe
deals.details: Free refills of hot or iced brewed coffee or tea during the same cafe visit. Excludes Cold Brew, Nitro Cold Brew, Iced Tea Lemonade, flavored iced tea and Refreshers.

chains.name: Dunkin'
chains.blurb: Coffee, donuts and breakfast sandwiches.

deals.title: $6 Meal Deal
deals.details: Bacon, Egg and Cheese Sandwich, Hash Browns and a medium hot or iced coffee for $6. Billed by Dunkin' as a limited-time offer but renewed through 2026; participation may vary.

chains.name: Tim Hortons
chains.blurb: Canadian coffee and donut chain with breakfast sandwiches and Timbits.

deals.title: $6 Tims Trio
deals.details: Medium hot brewed or iced coffee, one classic or specialty donut and one eligible hot breakfast sandwich for $6 at participating U.S. restaurants, in-store or in the app (higher prices on delivery).

chains.name: Dairy Queen
chains.blurb: Blizzards, soft serve and burger and chicken strip baskets.

deals.title: $7 Meal Deal
deals.details: Cheeseburger Meal Deal: cheeseburger, fries and a soft drink for $7 (a 3-piece chicken strip version is also listed). Participating locations; prices may vary.

deals.title: 2 for $5 Super Snack
deals.details: Mix and match two snack items (such as a small sundae or 2-piece chicken strips) for $5. Participating locations; at least one location lists it as 2 for $6.

chains.name: Sonic
chains.blurb: Drive-in with slushes, tots, burgers and coneys.

deals.title: Half-price Drinks and Slushes (SONIC Rewards)
deals.details: App-only: SONIC Rewards members choose one of three benefit offers each visit, including half-price Drinks and Slushes (others: a free snack or side, or $2 off a $10 order). Exclusions apply; not valid with combos or delivery.

deals.title: $1.99 Menu
deals.details: Value menu Sonic described as 'here to stay': items such as a Quarter Pound Double Cheeseburger, Chili Cheese Coney, queso wraps, small tots and 16 oz shakes at $1.99. Lineup has been revised over time; participating locations.

chains.name: Five Guys
chains.blurb: Made-to-order burgers with free toppings and fresh-cut fries.

chains.name: Steak 'n Shake
chains.blurb: Steakburgers and hand-dipped milkshakes.

deals.title: Half Price Happy Hour
deals.details: Half-price shakes and drinks on weekdays. The 2-5 pm window is as reported by third-party coverage (the official page was not readable in full); hours and participation vary by location.

chains.name: Culver's
chains.blurb: ButterBurgers, cheese curds and frozen custard with a Flavor of the Day.

chains.name: Swensons
chains.blurb: Akron-born drive-in with curbside service and the Galley Boy double cheeseburger.

chains.name: White Castle
chains.blurb: Columbus-based home of the original slider.

chains.name: Panda Express
chains.blurb: American Chinese bowls and plates, including Orange Chicken.

chains.name: Insomnia Cookies
chains.blurb: Warm cookies delivered late into the night.

chains.name: Crumbl
chains.blurb: Oversized cookies and desserts on a weekly rotating menu.

chains.name: Bibibop
chains.blurb: Columbus-based Korean-inspired build-your-own rice bowls.

chains.name: Piada
chains.blurb: Columbus-based Italian street food: piadas, pasta bowls and salads.

chains.name: Fusian
chains.blurb: Ohio-based build-your-own sushi rolls and bowls.

chains.name: Condado Tacos
chains.blurb: Columbus-born build-your-own taco joint with queso and margaritas.

chains.name: Roosters
chains.blurb: Ohio-based casual wing joint with daily specials.

chains.name: Waffle House
chains.blurb: 24-hour diner serving waffles, hashbrowns and breakfast all day.

chains.name: IHOP
chains.blurb: Pancake house with all-day breakfast.

chains.name: Applebee's
chains.blurb: Casual bar and grill with appetizers, burgers and late-night hours.

deals.title: Late Night Half-Price Appetizers
deals.details: Half-price select appetizers during late-night hours, dine-in only, at participating restaurants. Hours vary by location (one location page lists 10 pm-close every night); confirm with your local Applebee's.

deals.title: 2 for $25
deals.details: Two entrees plus one appetizer for $25, dine-in, To Go or delivery. Featured entrees rotate and the menu is billed as limited-time; price and participation vary by location.

chains.name: Kung Fu Tea
chains.blurb: Bubble tea chain with milk teas, slushes and punch.

chains.name: Bob Evans
chains.blurb: Ohio-founded farmhouse restaurant with breakfast and homestyle dinners.

chains.name: Graeter's
chains.blurb: Cincinnati French pot ice cream with oversized chocolate chips.

chains.name: Jeni's
chains.blurb: Columbus-born scoop shop with inventive ice cream flavors.

chains.name: Tropical Smoothie Cafe
chains.blurb: Smoothies, wraps, flatbreads and bowls.

chains.name: Sheetz
chains.blurb: 24/7 convenience store with made-to-order food and drinks.

chains.name: Wawa
chains.blurb: Convenience store known for built-to-order hoagies and coffee.

chains.name: GetGo
chains.blurb: Convenience store and cafe with made-to-order subs and fuel perks.
